name: bee-actions
description: Tool half of the Bee integration (channels-vs-tools split): agent-callable actions on the owner's Bee — read todos/conversations/facts, complete/create/edit todos (the captured-todo closed loop), confirm-gated deletes. Works against the local `bee login` proxy or the Bee cloud API. Config-only manifest — run scripts/bee_actions.py <verb>. Also declares the channel half's watcher config (the BEE_* keys ag2-sparrow's sources/bee.py resolves as CLI > env > manifest/package default).
